name: popsicle
headline: LLM-Driven Marketing Campaign Assistant
short_description: This Streamlit-based application uses Language Learning Models (LLMs) like Google Palm to assist in generating customized marketing content such as sales copy, tweets, and product descriptions. The app tailors content for specific target audiences, including kids, adults, and senior citizens.
author: mshaadk

sections.overview:
The LLM-Driven Marketing Campaign Assistant is a Streamlit application powered by Google's Palm API that automates marketing content creation. Users input a product name, select a task (sales copy, tweet, or product description), and choose a target audience (kids, adults, or senior citizens) to receive AI-generated, audience-specific messaging. The tool uses LangChain for prompt handling and few-shot learning to deliver relevant marketing copy. It solves the challenge of creating personalized marketing content at scale, benefiting marketing teams, small business owners, and content creators who need rapid, audience-tailored copy without manual rewriting.
Generate age-appropriate product descriptions for e-commerce platforms
Create targeted social media tweets for specific demographic groups
Develop sales copy tailored to kids, adults, or senior citizen audiences
Rapidly prototype marketing messaging for multiple audience segments
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/mshaadk/LLM-Driven-Marketing-Campaign-Assistant`
sections.usage:
```
Generate a marketing campaign for [COMPANY], a [INDUSTRY] company, targeting [TARGET_AUDIENCE]. Include a sales copy, 3 tweets, and a product description. Focus on [KEY_MESSAGE] and use a tone that resonates with [TARGET_AUDIENCE].
```
